nodes.label: CSP patch shape classification (append-arrays/append-string/middleware/meta-tag)
nodes.rationale: Shapes are named by patch mechanism, not framework origin, so the agent knows which patch template to propose; structured array patches are prioritized over string splices because they're safer, and middleware/meta-tag shapes are detect-only in v1 because they're less reliable to auto-patch.

nodes.label: AI-generated UI slop anti-patterns
nodes.rationale: Catalog of recurring visual/copy tells (side-tab borders, overused fonts, gradient text, AI color palettes, icon-tile-above-heading, hero eyebrows, em-dash overuse, marketing buzzwords) that mark AI-generated UI output, used to drive both highlighting overlays and CLI findings.

nodes.label: jsdom CSS var()/oklch() resolution workaround
nodes.rationale: jsdom does not resolve var(--X) custom properties or compute oklch()/Tailwind v4 color tokens, so the detector builds a custom-property map and an oklch->rgb converter to avoid false negatives across all color/contrast/typography checks in the Node path; real browsers don't need this.

nodes.label: runHook
nodes.rationale: All errors swallowed at the runHook seam so the detector throwing never breaks a turn (PRD §5 failure modes).

nodes.label: expandScanTargets
nodes.rationale: Co-scans sibling/co-located stylesheets so a JSX/TSX edit doesn't report clean while styles.css still has overused fonts/bounce animations.

nodes.label: directiveFooter
nodes.rationale: Imperative wording with explicit exception clause and acknowledgement instruction, since hook output is injected as developer-role context invisible to the user.

nodes.label: hook-before-edit.mjs main
nodes.rationale: Cursor stop hook is not consistently dispatched, so this preToolUse write gate checks proposed Write/Edit content before it lands; never breaks a turn on malformed input.

nodes.label: hook.mjs main
nodes.rationale: PostToolUse entry point; thin stdin/stdout shim over runHook so logic is unit-testable without a subprocess.

nodes.label: parseDesignMd
nodes.rationale: Two-layer parse: YAML frontmatter (machine-readable tokens) plus markdown body with six canonical H2 sections, frontmatter values preferred with prose fallback.

nodes.label: parseYamlSubset
nodes.rationale: Minimal indent-based 2-space YAML reader for Stitch frontmatter subset; deliberately avoids vendoring a full YAML dependency since the schema doesn't need arrays/anchors/multiline scalars.

nodes.label: isGeneratedFile
nodes.rationale: Detects regenerated files (git check-ignore, then GENERATED/DO NOT EDIT header markers) so live-mode never writes into files a build step will silently wipe.

nodes.label: acceptCli
nodes.rationale: Deterministic accept/discard of variant sessions: for accept, replaces wrapper with chosen variant and preserves colocated <style> with carbonize markers for later integration.

nodes.label: expandReplaceRange
nodes.rationale: For JSX wrappers the marker comments live inside the outer <div data-impeccable-variants> to keep a single child slot; this walks back to the opener and forward by div-depth tracking to find the real replace range.

nodes.label: scrubManualEditsAgainstOriginalBlock
nodes.rationale: Drops only buffer ops whose text appeared inside the just-accepted wrapper's original block, narrowing scope from the prior unsafe file-wide scrub that dropped unrelated staged edits.

nodes.label: createLiveBrowserSessionState
nodes.rationale: Durable session state (checkpoint revision, handled markers, scroll position) attached to window.__IMPECCABLE_LIVE_SESSION__, served before live-browser.js for recovery support.

nodes.label: commitManualEdits
nodes.rationale: Builds page-scoped batch via buildManualEditEvidence, applies through a local AI runner, verifies and rolls back unverified/unreported source changes, retries via repairPostApplyValidation, then clears applied buffer entries.

nodes.label: completeCli
nodes.rationale: Canonical durable completion ack for live sessions; tries the running live server first, falling back to appending directly to the session store.

nodes.label: runCopyEditBatchAgent
nodes.rationale: Wakes a local AI coding agent (Codex/Claude/chat/mock) to apply a staged copy-edit batch to true source files, with strict rules against copying browser edit-mode scaffolding into source.

nodes.label: runClaude
nodes.rationale: Forwards env (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) so a non-TTY subprocess can authenticate, since macOS Keychain creds from `claude /login` are unreachable from a headless child.

nodes.label: live-discard-manual-edits.mjs script
nodes.rationale: Drops pending manual edits from the buffer with no source writes; only runs when the user explicitly asks to discard staged edits.

nodes.label: injectCli
nodes.rationale: Deterministically inserts/removes the live variant mode <script> tag at a framework-specific anchor, generated once by the agent and then handled with zero LLM involvement on subsequent runs.

nodes.label: patchCspMeta
nodes.rationale: Appends localhost origin to script-src/connect-src (and blob: to img-src for the generating overlay) and stashes the original CSP content base64-encoded for exact revert on remove.

nodes.label: insertCli
nodes.rationale: Finds an anchor element via live-wrap query helpers and splices an insert-variant wrapper before/after it for net-new content (no original variant).

nodes.label: buildManualEditEvidence
nodes.rationale: Gathers staged browser edits, rendered context, framework source hints, and likely source candidates without editing files or choosing a winner, so the AI copy-edit batch runner has full repo context.

nodes.label: OKLCH palette composition strategy
nodes.rationale: Single anchor seed + model-composed 5-role palette avoids the 'claude-beige'/AI-cliché attractor zones; tested empirically to win mood-fit 3/5 vs curated 4-color presets.
